description:
You are a mechanical engineer updating the energy model for a 4-Storey office building (4StoreyBuilding). To meet new Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) standards, the design has been changed from plenum return to fully ducted return. You must update ALL 15 packaged single-zone (PSZ) HVAC systems (Ground, Middle, and Top floors) in the model.

For each system (G.*, M.*, and T.*):
1. Change the Return Air Path (RETURN-AIR-PATH) to 'DUCTED'.
2. Set the Return Fan/Duct Static Pressure (RETURN-STATIC) to 0.75 in. w.g. to account for the new ductwork friction loss.

After updating all 15 systems, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
